title: Pike Davis, first trumpet in Blackbirds
summary: Davis was a legitimate first trumpeter with a standoffish personality who always worked in shows.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: : Did you know Pike Davis at all?
Pike Davis was -- I met him, too. He
was the first trumpet player with the Blackbirds. He always played first trumpet.
He was a legit trumpet player. I never heard him play jazz but a very good trumpet player, but he had a funny personality.
Is that so? I didn't know that.

You couldn't talk to him, you know. You didn't talk to him much. If you was a kid or younger musician, he wouldn't have much to do with you, you know. And he wasn't a guy that I hung around too much. But he always worked. He always worked, always. He was a -- he had a big name as being a first trumpet player. He always played shows, you know, legitimate shows.
Fantastic. They wouldn't go out on the road with the Blackbirds without him, you know.
Beautiful. That's just what I heard. I never got to know him.
